resources.string: The whole Mac desktop through macOS\'s own Screen Sharing; nothing to install on the Mac (experimental)

Turn on Screen Sharing on the Mac (System Settings › General › Sharing). Address on the local network or Tailscale. The password is asked when connecting; you can choose to keep it, encrypted and unlocked with your fingerprint or screen lock. The connection stays while you switch to other apps, until you disconnect it or end XDesk.
